content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Rockford

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Review your degree level and years of hands-on project leadership. Granite PM Academy's advisors can clarify whether your background qualifies before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Attend Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. You'll cover the PMBOK® Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world case studies across scheduled sessions designed for working professionals in Rockford.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: File your PMP application with PMI and remit the exam fee after completing your coursework with us. Our team will guide you through the online submission process and answer questions about required documentation.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor office hours—to build confidence. Schedule your exam when you're ready and take it at an approved Pearson VUE testing center.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) over the standard three-year renewal cycle to keep your certification active. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing learning opportunities and recertification support for credential holders.
